Class AppointmentService

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.salonapp.services.AppointmentService
public class AppointmentService extends Object
Represents the actions of handling appointments

This class provides all CRUD functionality of appointments

      public void createAppointment(Customer customer, Stylist stylist, LocalDateTime appointmentTime)
      Creates an appointment and stores it in the list of appointments
      Parameters:
      customer - this is the customer scheduling the appointment
      stylist - this is the stylist who the customer wants to cut their hair
      appointmentTime - this is the appointment date and time that the customer has chosen

    • updateAppointment

      public void updateAppointment(int appointmentID, Stylist stylist, LocalDateTime appointmentTime, Appointment.Status status)
      Update the selected appointment attributes
      Parameters:
      appointmentID - this is the appointment we want to update
      stylist - this is the new or current stylist
      appointmentTime - this is the new time of the appointment. Set null if not being changed
      status - this is the new status of the appointment. Set null if not being changed
